history.motion: Restrained and coherent: rows fade up in sequence, the sparkline draws itself in over two frames, nav compacts on scroll; nothing overshoots.

history.gap: The schematic sparkline is the weak element: on desktop it is a decorative stock-looking squiggle that says nothing "Gratis/Premium" does not already say, and on mobile it is simply clipped off the left edge with the NU hairline and LATER dotted rule running full-bleed behind centred type, while the caption "TWEE NIVEAUS, SCHEMATISCH" alone flips to right-aligned. At the bar the figure is either redrawn as a proper full-width diagram with NU/LATER as inline labels tied to the two tiers, or dropped on mobile, and every caption obeys the same alignment as the column. Also reconsider the inverted hierarchy: the free tier is set small italic and the premium tier large roman for no legible reason.
history.motion: Orderly staggered fade-up of blocks with the sparkline drawing in — restrained and consistent, if a little generic.
history.verdict: A is a disciplined dark-and-gold editorial block with real typographic control (spaced caps, hairline buttons, a considered measure) let down by a decorative chart that breaks on mobile and an inverted tier hierarchy. B leans on beautiful stock-feeling photography while the actual design fails at the basics — illegible copy over the image, a label crashing into the logo, broken word spacing and a mobile dead zone — so A wins comfortably, though neither is shortlist-ready.
